_comment: Index-parking ledger for the agentic account (••••3900) — the 'waiting ground'. When agentic-deploy.mjs defers a target name (below/above entry, earnings, policy, wash), its dollars are parked in a broad-market placeholder instead of idling in cash, and released to fund the name when it clears. raw/ is wiped every run and the executor may not write data.json, so this COMMITTED file is the only place the state can live (same pattern as agentic-target.json / agentic-decisions.json). build-data.mjs reads it into data.agentic.parked; the executor rewrites it after a park or release FILLS. dollars = cost basis currently parked on behalf of forNames (not market value).
